mapper.select: SELECT Bdd_Id, Bdd_Parent_Id, Bdd_Number, Bdd_Code, Bdd_Name, Bdd_Total FROM Inv_Budget_Declare_Dtl WHERE Bd_Id = #{bdId} AND COALESCE(deleted, 0) = 0 ORDER BY Bdd_Order, Bdd_Id

SELECT b.Bdd_Id, COALESCE(SUM(c.Con_Money_Total), 0) AS conMoneyTotal FROM Con_Contract c INNER JOIN Inv_Budget_Declare_Dtl b ON b.Bdd_Id = c.Con_Budget_Id WHERE c.Con_Project_Id = #{pId} AND b.Bd_Id = #{bdId} AND COALESCE(b.deleted, 0) = 0 GROUP BY b.Bdd_Id

SELECT b.Bdd_Id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.Pay_Application_Date) AS year, COALESCE(SUM(p.Pay_Payable), 0) AS amount FROM Con_Pay p INNER JOIN Con_Contract c ON c.Con_Id = p.Con_Id INNER JOIN Inv_Budget_Declare_Dtl b ON b.Bdd_Id = c.Con_Budget_Id WHERE c.Con_Project_Id = #{pId} AND b.Bd_Id = #{bdId} AND COALESCE(b.deleted, 0) = 0 AND p.Pay_State = 7 AND p.Pay_Source = '02' GROUP BY b.Bdd_Id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.Pay_Application_Date)

SELECT b.Bdd_Id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.Pay_Application_Date) AS year, COALESCE(SUM(p.Pay_Payable), 0) AS amount FROM Con_Pay p INNER JOIN Con_Contract c ON c.Con_Id = p.Con_Id INNER JOIN Inv_Budget_Declare_Dtl b ON b.Bdd_Id = c.Con_Budget_Id WHERE c.Con_Project_Id = #{pId} AND b.Bd_Id = #{bdId} AND COALESCE(b.deleted, 0) = 0 AND p.Pay_State = 7 AND (p.Pay_Source = '01' OR p.Pay_Source IS NULL OR TRIM(p.Pay_Source) = '') GROUP BY b.Bdd_Id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.Pay_Application_Date)

SELECT s.Bdd_Id, COALESCE(SUM(d.D_Amount), 0) AS tenderControlPrice FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT b.Bdd_Id, c.Con_Section_Id AS Sec_Id FROM Con_Contract c INNER JOIN Inv_Budget_Declare_Dtl b ON b.Bdd_Id = c.Con_Budget_Id WHERE c.Con_Project_Id = #{pId} AND b.Bd_Id = #{bdId} AND COALESCE(b.deleted, 0) = 0 AND c.Con_Section_Id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(c.Con_Section_Id) != '' ) s LEFT JOIN Sec_Document d ON d.Sec_Id = s.Sec_Id AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM Sec_Document newer WHERE newer.Sec_Id = d.Sec_Id AND ( (d.D_Create_Time IS NULL AND newer.D_Create_Time IS NOT NULL) OR newer.D_Create_Time > d.D_Create_Time OR ( (newer.D_Create_Time = d.D_Create_Time OR (newer.D_Create_Time IS NULL AND d.D_Create_Time IS NULL)) AND newer.D_Id > d.D_Id ) ) ) GROUP BY s.Bdd_Id
